outcomes.question: Does the article ever use the word "cyanobacteria"?
outcomes.text:
Yes. It appears once, in the pretraining section: "Humans, one might say, are the cyanobacteria of AI" [spya-h74fhr]. The sentence says we constantly emit structured data, which a model has to learn to understand in order to predict it.
